subject: NovaHealth inference fit — evidence kit, model recommendations & next steps
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:20:12-05:00
Subject: NovaHealth — quick recap, recommended models & evidence pack

Hi Emma — great call earlier. Quick recap and the materials I promised: 

Key outcomes (2 min):
- Primary workload: clinical note summarization + triage routing (avg input length ~1.2k tokens, 95th 2.6k).
- Success metrics: recall on critical entities, hallucination rate target <1.5%, and p99 latency <= 450ms for single-request inference in your EU region (we discussed US region first).
- Ops constraints: SLO-driven availability, and procurement will ask for throughput pricing for 100 TPS burst scenarios.

What I attached/shared: 
- Redwood-verified performance profiles for recommended variants (links below). Profiles include TPS, p50/p90/p99 latency, and median cost/token.
- Prompt set used in our bench runs: nova_prompt_set_v1.txt (contains clinical prompts + edge cases you flagged).
- End-to-end bench traces (redwood_bench_traces_nh-4301.zip) with token-level timing and KV cache behavior for repeat-context sessions.
- Draft mutual action plan: mutual_action_plan_NH-4301.pdf (milestones, success criteria, owner matrix).

High-level model recommendations (based on your quality vs cost preferences):
1) open-llm-clarity-13B-q4f (best cost/latency balance for 1–10 TPS sustained; 32-bit FP runs): verified at 18 TPS sustained, p99=420ms on gtx-class instance.
2) rdx-turbo-70B-8bit (recommended if recall/QA is strict; slightly higher latency but better factuality): verified 6 TPS sustained, p99=610ms, p90=280ms.
3) rdx-small-7B-quant (fallback for low-cost batch inference; ideal for background bulk summarization): verified 45 TPS batched, p99=1200ms (batching tradeoffs).

Immediate asks / next steps: 
- Please confirm procurement contact for a capacity/price worksheet (I copied your procurement alias).
- If you want, we can kick off a 3-day pilot: Redwood runs the prompt set against the recommended two model variants and returns a short quality matrix + latency traces. Would you like Friday (Dec 4) as a tentative pilot start?

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_ExampleBenchmarks (bench traces + profiles)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/564738/NH-2026-4301

Thanks again — I’ll loop in Laura for pilot ops and Karthik for pricing.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments (inlined):
- nova_prompt_set_v1.txt (text, 18 KB)
- redwood_bench_traces_nh-4301.zip (zip, 46 MB)
- mutual_action_plan_NH-4301.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)

From: Emma Larson <emma@novahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-12-01T18:03:47-05:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth — quick recap, recommended models & evidence pack

Thanks Nikhil — this is excellent and aligns with our note volume. A couple quick clarifications: 

- For triage routing we need p99 under 500ms for interactive routing (noting some users will be on mobile). You’ve listed 420ms for the 13B — are those numbers measured with our prompt set (the one with long patient notes)?
- For the pilot, can the 3-day run include a small A/B sample on production-like traffic (we can provide anonymized sample logs)?

Procurement looped in — procure@novahealth.com — can you prepare a one-pager with: expected unit price at 10k tokens/day, estimated monthly cost for the pilot, and a simple pricing slab for 0–50 / 50–200 / 200+ TPS? That will speed approvals.

Also copying Alex (cloud ops) to confirm network egress and region specifics.

Emma Larson
Director, Clinical Products
NovaHealth
emma@novahealth.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Wong <alex.wong@cloudops.io>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:12:05-05:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth — quick recap, recommended models & evidence pack

Thanks Emma — answers inline and a proposed pilot cadence: 

- Latency numbers: yes — the 420ms p99 for open-llm-clarity-13B-q4f was measured with the nova_prompt_set_v1 (we ran two sets: short notes and long notes). For long notes (95th length ~2.6k tokens) the p99 rose to ~540ms when run on single-request synchronous mode without KV reuse. The bench traces folder includes per-request traces marked by prompt id.

- Pilot A/B: absolutely — we can run an A/B where we route 10% of anonymized production traffic (you provide logs) to the two model variants for 72 hours. Deliverables: quality matrix (precision/recall on critical entities), hallucination rate, token cost, and full latency traces.

- Pricing one-pager: Karthik will draft the pricing slab and a sample monthly estimate. Karthik — can you populate the sheet with both hosted and Dedicated/reserved options? I’ve added a short checklist in the mutual action plan PDF for approvals.

Proposed pilot start: 2026-12-06 (Monday) to allow procurement review this week. If that works, we’ll prepare the pilot runbook and a short whitelist for your anonymized logs.

Best,
Nikhil

Attachments referenced in this thread: mutual_action_plan_NH-4301.pdf (owner matrix + dates)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: procure@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-12-03T09:05:33-05:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth — quick recap, recommended models & evidence pack

Emma / team — attaching the requested pricing one-pager and a quick capacity worksheet (see attachments). Highlights: 

- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): estimated pilot cost (72h A/B, 2 variants, 10% of sample traffic) = $1,850 — includes trace capture and analysis.
- Dedicated (reserved): monthly commit slab that hits your 100 TPS burst needs starts at $28,000/mo for a 6-month commit (includes burst pool and priority routing).
- Example slabs (hosted): 0–50 TPS = $0.0075/token gen; 50–200 TPS = $0.0055/token gen; 200+ = negotiated. (sheet has per-token estimates and examples for 10k tokens/day).

Next items from us:
- Nikhil: finalize pilot runbook and share data-whitelist instructions for anonymized logs.
- Emma: confirm pilot start (we proposed Dec 6) and provide procurement PO contact if needed.
- Procure@novahealth.com: if you want a formal MSA redline, let us know and we’ll loop legal.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
